_meta.description: RegWatch central referential — legal categories and sub-categories. Single source of truth for all agents.

legal_categories.label: Electronic / Measuring devices
legal_categories.description: All electronic and measuring products sold by Decathlon, from basic electronic equipment to connected devices.

classification_rules.fallback_rule: CAT3 applies to ALL electronic products — no exception. Every product implementing electronics receives CAT3 as a base.
classification_rules.specificity_rule: Sub-categories (CAT5, CAT7, CAT8, CAT9) are added ONLY when the specific protocol is EXPLICITLY confirmed in the product specs or description. When in doubt, CAT3 alone is sufficient.
classification_rules.multi_label_rule: A product can and must have all applicable sub-categories simultaneously (e.g. CAT3 + CAT7 + CAT9 for a GPS Bluetooth watch).

subcategories.label: Battery and accumulators (including component)
subcategories.definition: This category stands for batteries defined as component (element inside finished good) and finished good (sold directly to the end consumer/spare parts). A battery is defined by its chemistry (lithium Li, Nickel NiMh, Alkaline...) and classification: primary and secondary. A primary battery is a non rechargeable battery (e.g. alkaline LR03 AAA, alkaline LR06 AA, lithium coin CR2032). A secondary battery is a rechargeable battery. Decathlon almost uses lithium technology but sometimes nickel. An alkaline primary battery is a quite safe technology, while lithium coin batteries are considered dangerous due to flammability of lithium and high swallowing risk for children.
subcategories.scope: Batteries as component (inside finished good) and as finished good. Covers primary (non-rechargeable: alkaline, lithium coin) and secondary (rechargeable: lithium, NiMH) batteries. STRICT RULE: applies ONLY when the product IS a battery. If a product simply uses batteries as its power source, CAT1 does NOT apply.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply ONLY when the product IS a battery sold as finished good to end consumer OR identified as battery component. Do NOT apply when product merely uses batteries as power source.

subcategories.label: Lamp (cap lamp, LED, neon lantern, rainproof torch)
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products which primary function is lighting such as torch light, dynamo light, headlight, bike light. Common used technology for the lighting function is the LED. Every product in this category is already submitted to requirements from the Electronic equipments category which is the basis. According to the different functions and technologies implemented in the product, other categories shall be consulted such as battery, adaptor/transformator, rechargeable products etc. Products can be submitted to road regulation for bike lights.
subcategories.scope: Products whose primary function is lighting: torch, dynamo light, headlight, bike light. LED technology predominant. Always combined with CAT3 as base. May also combine with CAT1 (battery) or CAT4 (rechargeable).
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply when the PRIMARY function of the product is lighting. Always combined with CAT3.

subcategories.label: Electronic equipments (cardiofrequency, stopwatch, compass, disposable cameras, fitness console, pedometer, altimeter, watches)
subcategories.definition: This category stands for EVERY product implementing electronics. It groups every basic requirement for electronics. Every electronic product is concerned but pay attention that additional categories can apply linked to the implemented function and technologies. If your product implements wireless function please refer to meteorological/mini radio/GPS category. If your product implements household function (to charge or run the product) please refer to sun charger/electrical charger category. The only exception are the batteries, defined in the battery category.
subcategories.scope: Universal base category — every product implementing electronics falls here. Mandatory parachute. Additional sub-categories apply on top based on specific confirmed technologies.
subcategories.classification_rule: MANDATORY for every electronic product — no exception. Always assigned first. Other sub-categories are added on top.

subcategories.label: Sun charger, Electrical charger, USB charger, adaptor/transformator, rechargeable products
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products as photovoltaic, household adapter, and product with rechargeable function (linked to secondary batteries). Every product in this category is already submitted to requirements from the Electronic equipments category which is the basis. You can also refer to other categories depending of the technology implemented. In this category, the household adapter requirements are specifically detailed.
subcategories.scope: Photovoltaic products, household adapters, products with rechargeable function linked to secondary batteries. Always combined with CAT3.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply when product has a secondary (rechargeable) battery OR USB/mains charging capability. Always combined with CAT3.

subcategories.label: Camera video (with laser device) + remote control using ANT+
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products with wireless function such as ANT+, and cameras with laser device. Every product in this category is already submitted to requirements from the Electronic equipments category which is the basis. You can also refer to GPS category, bluetooth category and rechargeable products category depending of the technology implemented.
subcategories.scope: Products with wireless function using ANT+ protocol specifically, cameras with laser device, remote controls using ANT+. Always combined with CAT3.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply ONLY when ANT+ protocol is EXPLICITLY confirmed in product specs or description. Do not apply based on assumption.

subcategories.label: MP3 player
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products with specifically MP3 function. Every product in this category is already submitted to requirements from the Electronic equipments category which is the basis. You can also refer to bluetooth category, rechargeable products category depending of the technology implemented.
subcategories.scope: Products with specifically MP3 audio playback function as primary feature. Always combined with CAT3. May also combine with CAT9 (bluetooth) and CAT4 (rechargeable).
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply when MP3 audio playback is the primary or a key function of the product. Always combined with CAT3.

subcategories.label: Meteorological station, Mini radio, Global Position System, Talkie walkie, Telemeter
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products with wireless function such as GPS, radar, walkie talkie protocol, wifi etc. Products with wireless function are called ITE (Information and Technology Equipments) since information (data) are transmitted thanks to a specific wireless protocol. Wireless protocols are defined by 2 parameters: frequency bands and power. Certain frequency bands are submitted to specific regulation or forbidden. According to the signal power, additional tests can apply to ensure safety of the end user. The minimal power before entering additional safety test is 500mW (SAR). Telemeter is generally linked to laser technology which is submitted to safety tests to avoid eye injury.
subcategories.scope: Products with wireless function: GPS, radar, walkie-talkie, meteorological sensors, laser telemeter. ITE category. SAR applies above 500mW. Always combined with CAT3.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply ONLY when EXPLICITLY confirmed: GPS module, radio reception, walkie-talkie, meteorological sensors, or laser telemeter. SAR testing required above 500mW.

subcategories.label: Mobile Phone / products with wifi
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products with GSM/4G/5G function and also wifi protocol. They are linked to products with wireless function (ITE). Wireless protocols are defined by frequency bands and power. SAR applies above 500mW. Wifi is a protocol submitted to specific royalty fees if you want to use the logo. Cybersecurity rules apply to connected products.
subcategories.scope: Products with GSM/4G/5G and/or WiFi protocol. ITE category. SAR may apply. Cybersecurity rules apply. Always combined with CAT3.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply ONLY when wifi or GSM/4G/5G is EXPLICITLY confirmed in product specs. Always combined with CAT3.
key_regulations: GDPR — data protection (if personal data processed)

subcategories.label: Electronic equipment using bluetooth (bluetooth watch, earplug bluetooth...)
subcategories.definition: This category stands for products with wireless function using bluetooth technology. Products with wireless function are called ITE (Information and Technology Equipments). Bluetooth is a universal protocol with allowed frequency bands. Cybersecurity rules can apply. SAR considerations may apply depending on power level.
subcategories.scope: Products with Bluetooth wireless function (BLE or Classic). ITE category. Universal protocol with allowed frequency bands. Cybersecurity rules apply. Always combined with CAT3.
subcategories.classification_rule: Apply ONLY when Bluetooth is EXPLICITLY stated in product name, type, or description. BLE and Classic Bluetooth both qualify. Always combined with CAT3.
